title: Member Services Guidance Note: Medical Spending and Pharmacy Benefit Plan Accumulators
content:
Medical-claim feed postings — amounts arriving from the sponsor's medical carrier on the medical channel — are accepted on a Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment only where the design's accumulators are integrated with medical. Designs with separate pharmacy-only accumulators never take medical amounts, and a medical carrier's statement for a member on such a design is not posted.

## How medical amounts post on an integrated design

- Feeds arrive every medical feed interval of the design, counted in calendar days.
- Each medical amount posts with the medical service date as its accrual date.
- A medical amount posts to out-of-pocket and, to the extent the deductible is not yet met, to the deductible.

## Medical spending the member reports but the accumulators do not yet show

A member who reports medical spending not yet visible is told it posts with the next scheduled feed. Agents do not key medical amounts by hand.

## Points of judgement

| Design's accumulators | Medical-carrier amount or statement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Integrated with medical | Arrives by the scheduled feed | Posts to out-of-pocket, and to the deductible to the extent it is not yet met |
| Integrated with medical | Reported by the member, not yet visible | Member is told it posts with the next scheduled feed; no amount is keyed by hand |
| Separate pharmacy-only | Any medical amount or medical carrier's statement | Not posted |

## Illustration (hypothetical integrated design)

A member on a design integrated with medical has 150.00 of deductible remaining. A medical amount of 400.00, with a medical service date of 12 May, arrives by feed. It posts 400.00 to out-of-pocket and 150.00 to the deductible, each accruing to 12 May.
